messages:
jana-peopleops: FYI: Short compliance window coming up — evidence & attestations open Wed Apr 20 and close Mon May 1 23:59 UTC. Everyone with a Redwood account must attest or upload required evidence by the deadline. Form + Evidence Locker link: https://redwood.example.com/attest-2026 :calendar:

jana-peopleops: Highlights: - Complete the attestation form - Upload any applicable artifacts to the Evidence Locker - Team leads confirm direct reports on the form. Contractors: use the contractor checkbox and request a 7-day extension by Apr 26 if needed.

micah-eng: Quick clarifying Q: For model-serving teams, is a short architecture diagram + config snippet sufficient?

nina-security: Yes. Model teams: provide a dataflow diagram (even a simple drawio export) and a snippet showing encryption/default permissions. For infra owners: CMDB screenshot or asset list + a short note on patching cadence. If unsure, upload and tag for review.

oj-privacy: Reminder: the privacy micro-course (105 mins) must be completed before attestation. The form will show the link if your record is missing training. Please finish by Apr 28 to allow upload time.

announce-bot: Heads-up scheduled: "Compliance attestation window" will post in #general on Apr 22 09:00 UTC and an email reminder on Apr 29.

jana-peopleops: We're running two office hours: Apr 23 14:00-15:00 UTC and Apr 27 08:00-09:00 UTC. Drop-ins for artifact guidance + private slots via the form.

micah-eng: We'll gather artifacts at the squad level and submit via lead. I'll compile a list of owners by Apr 24.

nina-security: Upload items and mark them "for review" if you want us to confirm they meet SOC2/ISO scoping. We'll aim to close reviews by May 7. For urgent reviews (audit requests) tag @nina-security in the form.

jana-peopleops: TL;DR: attest + evidence due May 1 23:59 UTC; privacy training done by Apr 28; contractor extension requests by Apr 26; office hours Apr 23 & Apr 27. Please forward to any third-party vendors you manage. :white_check_mark:
